answer: The age coefficient in the simple logistic regression of camrelizumab treatment response (responder = PR vs non-responder = SD/PD) on age is approximately **−0.075 log-odds per year of age** (estimate −0.0750, SE 0.0244, z = −3.08, p ≈ 0.002; odds ratio ≈ 0.93 per year, 95% CI ≈ 0.88–0.97). Each additional year of age is associated with a ~7% decrease in the odds of response.
